value_tips.title: Value Ladder Framework
value_tips.content:
Hi {name},

Aapki industry mein jo players scale kar rahe, unka secret ek simple ladder:

₹5K → Entry consult (qualify)
₹50K → Pilot project (prove)
₹2.5L+ → Retainer (scale)

Most log ek hi price pe stuck hain... buyers ko choice nahi milta.

Hamari call mein aapke offer ke liye yeh map karenge based on your actual pipeline data.

Taiyaar rahiye! 📊

value_tips.title: Timeline vs Budget Matrix
value_tips.content:
{name}, quick heads-up:

Prospects jo "urgent" bolte hain but budget nahi—red flag 🚩
Prospects jo budget committed but timeline vague—yellow flag ⚠️

Best prospects: Clear timeline + Budget allocated = Green ✅

Call pe we'll map your prospects on this grid—you'll instantly see who's real aur kaun time-waste.

See you soon!
